name: rEngine native workspace
source: Extracted 2026-09-06 from orchestrator/native/*.c and the pinned microui default style. tools/design.py generates orchestrator/native/theme.h and the preview cards from this file.

typography.note: One trusted local monospace font at one size; cell width is the advance of 'M'. Bold is drawn by overstriking one pixel to the right; underline is a 1px rule. No italics, weights or second size exist natively.

canvas.role: Window clear colour behind and between panes

surface.role: Pane, toolbar, editor and terminal background
surface.native: MU_COLOR_WINDOWBG, editor buffer, terminal default background

control-hover.role: Button and tab under the pointer

field-hover.role: Textbox and checkbox under the pointer

border.role: 1px frame around buttons, fields and pane windows

text.role: Primary text, editor text, terminal default foreground
text.native: MU_COLOR_TEXT, editor text, terminal default foreground

text-indicator.role: Text on the terminal history indicator

title-bg.role: Reserved: microui title bars are disabled in every window

caret.role: Editor caret: 2px bar, or a full cell in Vim NORMAL

terminal-cursor.role: Terminal cursor cell while focused and live

scroll-track.role: Native terminal and editor scrollbar track

list-scroll-track.role: microui overflow scrollbar track in tree and session lists

game-backdrop.role: Letterbox behind the live game texture

metric-notes.microui: Upstream style defaults applied explicitly: content padding, row spacing, tree indent, unused title height, overflow scrollbar and thumb, default control width.
metric-notes.window: Initial SDL window size and the enforced minimum.
metric-notes.toolbar: Top window holding two 26px rows of controls.
metric-notes.workspace: Pane area starts below the toolbar and ends above the status line; splits leave a 6px draggable divider and keep panes at least 80px.
metric-notes.pane: Each leaf pane has a 34px header window; content starts at 35px with a 22px root-name row.
metric-notes.tab: Tab cells are 158px wide including a 22px close button; overflow adds 24px previous/next buttons; titles clip after 11 characters.
metric-notes.tree: Directory rows are 24px; the Up button is 55px wide.
metric-notes.sessions: Session rows are 26px with an 80px Attach button and a Stop button filling the rest.
metric-notes.editor: Save/Discard/mode/state row, then the buffer inset 6px from the pane, 59px from the content top and 85px above its bottom; a 23px error label sits at the bottom.
metric-notes.terminal: Terminal cells are inset 6px and start 28px below the content top.
metric-notes.game: Capture row above a black surface that starts 59px from the content top.
metric-notes.scrollbar: Native terminal/editor bars are 14px wide with a thumb of at least 20px inset 2px.
